Counsel for Applicant :- Dheeraj Awasthi,Krishna Kant Yadav,Rakesh Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Anil Kumar Awasthi

Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and learned counsel for the complainant.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. No. 282 of 2022, under Sections 376,452, 506, I.P.C., Police Station Safipur, District Unnao.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has falsely been implicated in the present case.
It is further submitted that the F.I.R. has been lodged by the informant with the false allegation that the applicant committed rape with the informant in the presence of his mother.
It is vehemently submits that it is highly improbable that the applicant committed rape with the informant in the presence of his mother.

Submission of the learned counsel for the applicant is that the present F.I.R. is nothing but a counter blast to the F.I.R. lodged by the mother of the applicant on 21.05.2022 against the son and husband of the informant bearing F.I.R. No. 221 of 2022, under Sections 452, 354, 504, 506 I.P.C., P.S. Safipur, District Unnao.
Learned counsel for the applicant also submits that vide order dated 28.01.2023, this Court granted interim bail to the applicant and Anuj Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

It is next submitted that the charge sheet has been filed and there is no possibility of tampering of any evidence.

Learned counsel for the applicant, while assuring that the applicant will cooperate in the investigation, submits that the police is trying to arrest applicant in the present case, who does not have any criminal antecedent.
In such circumstances, applicant is entitled for protection of this Court under the provisions of anticipatory bail.

Learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the complainant oppose the prayer of the applicant,
but do not dispute that the charge sheet has been filed.

Considering the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A.,
learned counsel for the complainant and going through the contents of the application and other relevant documents as well as earlier order passed by this Court dated 28.01.2023, it is evident that applicant was on interim bail during the course of investigation and he never misused the liberty of the same.
In such circumstances, the application stands allowed.

As the applicant has already furnished the personal bond and two sureties in pursuance of the order dated 28.01.2023, there is no need to furnish fresh bond and the earlier bond along with sureties shall be sufficient.

The applicant -Anuj Kumar is granted anticipatory bail in F.I.R. No. 282 of 2022, subject to the following conditions:-
(1) Applicant will not try to influence the witnesses or tamper with the evidence of the case or otherwise misuse the liberty of bail.
(2) Applicant will fully cooperate in expeditious disposal of the case and shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when witnesses are present in the Court.

(3) Applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (a) opening of the case, (b) framing of charge; and (c) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.
Any violation of above conditions will be treated misuse of bail and learned Court below will be at liberty to pass appropriate order in the matter regarding cancellation of bail.
